# 4 bed end of terrace house for sale

> A rare opportunity to acquire Benevenagh, a magnificent 4-bedroom end of terrace Victorian residence in the heart of Greystones Village, one of the town's most desirable locations, The Old Burnaby. Benevenagh is a home of exceptional character and fascinating history, having been the former home of legendary Irish musician Ronnie Drew, founding member of The Dubliners.

## Fakta
- Typ: end of terrace house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Plocha: 202.3 m²
- Energetická náročnost: C
- Lokalita: Benevenagh, Killincarrick Road, The Burnaby, Greystones
- Cena: 1 595 000 €
